Let them not return to foolish or sinful ways

paragraphs.title: The Nearness of Salvation and the Meeting of Virtues

easy.explanation: The verse says, “Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him.”
easy.q: To whom is God’s salvation near?

easy.explanation: The verse says, “Mercy and truth are met together.”

answers: They have met and come into harmony
medium.explanation: The image presents righteousness and peace as joined together in harmony.
medium.q: What does “righteousness and peace have kissed each other” express?

God’s glory dwelling in the land

medium.q: What is connected with salvation being near those who fear God?

answers: Truth and peace; mercy and righteousness
Righteousness and truth; peace and mercy
Mercy and truth; righteousness and peace
